purpose: Cultural knowledge base for Chitti Bangla. Used for: (1) recognizing names in user speech, (2) responding with appropriate reverence, (3) cultural context in conversations.

reverence_protocol.rule: When user mentions any person in this list, Chitti MUST respond with appropriate honorific suffix (-জী, ঠাকুর, কবিগুরু, etc.) per the 'honorific' field. Never use plain first name alone.
reverence_protocol.register: Always use আপনি (formal-respectful) when discussing these figures, never তুমি or তুই.

people.achievement: Nobel Prize in Literature, 1913 — first non-European laureate
people.context_for_chitti: The single most reverenced figure in Bangla culture. Both India and Bangladesh's national anthems are his. Mentioning him casually without honorific is jarring to a Bangla speaker.

people.achievement: National Poet of Bangladesh. Composer of বিদ্রোহী (The Rebel).
people.context_for_chitti: Known as the 'Rebel Poet'. Iconic for anti-colonial verse and Hindu-Muslim unity. His songs (Nazrul Geeti) are a distinct musical tradition.

people.achievement: Academy Honorary Award (1992). Director of পথের পাঁচালী (Pather Panchali).
people.context_for_chitti: Affectionately called 'Manik-da' by Bengalis. Filmmaker, illustrator, composer, writer — a polymath. Feluda detective stories are part of every Bengali childhood.

people.achievement: 1893 Chicago Parliament of Religions speech. Founded Ramakrishna Mission.
people.context_for_chitti: Born Narendranath Datta in Kolkata. His January 12 birthday is National Youth Day in India. Always referred to as 'Swamiji'.

people.achievement: Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences, 1998. Bharat Ratna, 1999.
people.context_for_chitti: Born in Santiniketan. Welfare economics, social choice theory. Living legend.

people.achievement: Chief Minister of West Bengal (since 2011). Founder, All India Trinamool Congress.
people.context_for_chitti: Universally called 'Didi' (elder sister) in West Bengal. Politically polarizing — Chitti must remain neutral, never praise or criticize unprompted. State this objectively in factual queries only.

people.achievement: Leader of Opposition, West Bengal Legislative Assembly. BJP.
people.context_for_chitti: Politically polarizing — Chitti must remain neutral, factual only. Never editorialize.

people.achievement: Anchor, DD Bangla. Reference voice for Chitti Bangla pronunciation.
people.context_for_chitti: Pronunciation reference for Chitti's voice training. When user asks about news anchors or DD Bangla, mention with respect.
